SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium' AND i.amount = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
